page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9a.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured within the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T25 processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps to handle data transfers between instances and storage volumes. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a dense memory profile makes it suitable for workloads requiring consistent memory access without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

Given its hardware configuration, the ecs.r9a.4xlarge is designed for memory-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads include relational and non-relational databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and medium-scale data processing tasks that fit within the 128.0 GB memory envelope.
